panel.label: Salesforce ⇄ jCustomer Sync
panel.title: Salesforce ⇄ jCustomer Connector
panel.subtitle: Sync Contact, Account and Lead data from Salesforce into jCustomer profile properties.

connection.title: Salesforce Connection
connection.subtitle: Enter your Salesforce Connected App credentials. The private key must be an unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----); convert a PKCS#1 key (-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----) with: openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in old.key -out key.pem. Upload the matching public certificate to the Connected App.

clientId.label: Client ID (Consumer Key)
clientId.placeholder: Consumer key of the Connected App

apiVersion.label: API version
apiVersion.hint: Leave empty to use {{version}} (sfdc.api.version in the OSGi configuration).

privateKey.label: Private key (PEM, PKCS#8)
privateKey.placeholderStored: A key is already stored - paste a new PEM to replace it
privateKey.stored: Private key stored - leave empty to keep it

mapping.title: Field Mapping
mapping.subtitle: Map Salesforce Contact, Account and Lead fields to jCustomer profile properties. Email (→ email) is required for profile matching.
mapping.empty: No mappings configured. Click "Add mapping" to start.

export.csvTip: Download the {{obj}} field mapping as a CSV file
export.jsonTip: Download the {{obj}} field mapping as a JSON file

sync.title: Last synchronisation
sync.subtitle: Monitor the last sync status.

triggers.title: Sync triggers
triggers.subtitle: Choose which events trigger a Salesforce data sync into jCustomer.

login.label: Login trigger
login.desc: Sync this user's SF data immediately on every Jahia login (OIDC, local). Runs asynchronously — login is not delayed.

scheduler.label: Scheduled batch
scheduler.desc: Sync all subscribed users on a cron schedule. Uses delta sync (LastModifiedDate filter).
scheduler.cronHint: Format: second minute hour day month weekday — e.g. 0 0 5 * * ? = daily at 05:00 UTC

manual.label: Manual sync
manual.desc: Full sync of all mapped contacts immediately (ignores lastSyncAt delta).

sync.started: Sync started in background. Refresh in a few seconds to see the result.
sync.info: The scheduled batch sync runs daily at 05:00 UTC. A login-triggered sync also fires automatically when a user logs in. Configure the schedule in the OSGi configuration file.

mapping.title: Outbound Field Mapping
mapping.subtitle: Map jCustomer profile properties to Salesforce Lead and Contact fields. Matched records are updated; unmatched profiles create a new one.
mapping.requiredHint: Salesforce requires {{fields}} to create a {{obj}} — map them, or only existing {{obj}} records will be updated.

triggers.title: Sync to Salesforce
triggers.subtitle: The connector polls jCustomer for changed profiles and pushes them to Salesforce as Leads.
triggers.pollStarted: Sync started in the background — check the last outbound run for results.

what.title: What to sync
what.subtitle: Turn on the changes to push to Salesforce automatically. jCustomer is polled on the schedule below while at least one is on; "Sync now" runs the same push immediately.

target.label: Target Salesforce object
target.desc: Push profiles to this object only. Configure its field mapping in the Field Mapping tab.

profileUpdate.label: Profile updates
profileUpdate.desc: Push profiles whose properties changed since the last run. An email is required to match or create the Lead.

formSubmission.label: Form submissions
formSubmission.desc: Push profiles that submitted a form since the last run.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: How often jCustomer is polled for changes while a trigger above is on.
schedule.active: Changes are pushed automatically on this schedule, starting from the moment a trigger was turned on.
schedule.inactive: No trigger is on: nothing is pushed automatically. Turn on Profile updates or Form submissions above.

sync.title: Push to Salesforce
sync.subtitle: Push a jCustomer profile to a Salesforce Lead (matched by email; created if none exists). Event-based and scheduled pushes are configured separately.
sync.emailRequired: Enter a profile email to push.
